# llms.txt for ericyiwusourcing.com
# Last updated: 2026-05-26

## About

Eric Ma (YiwuMarketConnect) is a personal Yiwu sourcing agent based in Yiwu, 
Zhejiang Province, China. Since 2018, he has worked as a full-time sourcing 
agent at Yiwu International Trade City — the world's largest wholesale market 
for small consumer goods.

Eric specializes in helping small business owners, online sellers (Amazon, 
eBay, Etsy), boutique brands, and shop owners source products from China with 
low minimum order quantities (MOQ 50-100 pieces), verified suppliers, and 
quality inspection services.

He works with clients from 30+ countries across Europe, North America, the 
Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

## Services

1. Product Sourcing
   - Visit 5-10 suppliers at Yiwu Market
   - Collect real product photos and samples
   - Send comparison report with MOQ, price, and lead time
   - 2-3 day initial response

2. Supplier Verification
   - Check business licenses and credentials
   - Visit supplier booths and factories
   - Verify production capacity and export experience

3. Quality Inspection
   - Pre-shipment inspection with photos and videos
   - Check quantity, colors, materials, and defects
   - 100% of orders inspected before shipping

4. Custom Packaging & Private Label
   - Logo printing and custom box design
   - Coordinate mockups and production samples
   - Verify final packaging matches requirements

5. Shipping Coordination
   - Sea freight (FCL/LCL), air freight, express courier
   - Coordinate with trusted freight forwarders
   - Door-to-door or port-to-port options

## Key Facts

- Experience: 5+ years as Yiwu Market agent (since 2018)
- Countries served: 30+ (USA, UK, Germany, Netherlands, Australia, Canada, 
  France, UAE, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, etc.)
- Products sourced: 500+ across 8 categories
- Quality check rate: 100%
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Market presence: 5 days per week at Yiwu Market and supplier factories
- Communication: WhatsApp, email, photo/video updates
- Languages: Works with professional translation tools for accuracy

## Product Categories

1. Toys & Games (educational toys, plushies, outdoor games)
2. Pet Products (accessories, grooming tools, toys)
3. Gifts & Home Decor (decorative items, candles, seasonal gifts)
4. Kitchen & Dining (tools, tableware, storage)
5. Stationery & Office (school supplies, planners, accessories)
6. Beauty & Personal Care (cosmetic tools, hair accessories, travel kits)
7. Fashion Accessories (bags, jewelry, scarves, hats)
8. Sports & Outdoor (fitness gear, camping accessories)

## Pricing & MOQ

- Sourcing agent commission: 5-10% of order value
- Typical MOQ: 50-100 pieces per product
- Standard payment: 30% deposit + 70% after inspection
- Free initial quote and supplier comparison
